# Hello World PowerShell Script

```powershell
Write-Host "Hello, World!"
```

## How to Run

1. Save the file as `hello.ps1`
2. Open PowerShell
3. Navigate to the file's directory
4. Run it:

```powershell
.\hello.ps1
```

> **Note:** If you get an execution policy error, you can run:
> ```powershell
> Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned
> ```
> This allows locally-created scripts to run.
